name: vtgmilksetu
description: VTG MilkSetu — backend API + admin panel, deployed as one Node service

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix admin install --include=dev
scripts._comment_render: Render/Railway build command: just `npm run render-build`
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:backend
